about.title: A clearer and faster way to reserve campus spaces.
about.body: HFI Utility Center is the classroom reservation and approval platform for HFI students, teachers and administrators. Web and iOS share live catalog data, room policies and approval states.
about.principleBody: Reduce waiting, make availability clear, and keep booking and administration consistent in Chinese and English.
about.privacyBody: The reservation list preserves the public query behavior of the existing main version. Submissions, approvals and facility changes always use server data as the source of truth.
